"""Live controller for the RoboCasa GR1 Pick-and-Place episode.
Uses only RGB/depth observations, calibration and robot proprioception.
"""
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

CAMERAS = ["robot0_agentview_center", "robot0_agentview_right", "egoview",
           "robot0_eye_in_right_hand", "robot0_eye_in_left_hand"]

def command_from_proprio(r):
    spec = r.spec()
    o = r.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video="none")
    layout = o.meta["proprio"]["layout"]
    now = np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
    idx = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(layout)}
    row = np.zeros(24, dtype=np.float64)
    for j, name in enumerate(spec["action_types"]["ee_pose"]["layout"]):
        if name.startswith("right_") and name[6:] in ("x", "y", "z", "rx", "ry", "rz", "little", "ring", "middle", "index", "thumb_flexion", "thumb_rotation"):
            p = "cmd_" + name
        elif name.startswith("left_") and name[5:] in ("x", "y", "z", "rx", "ry", "rz", "little", "ring", "middle", "index", "thumb_flexion", "thumb_rotation"):
            p = "cmd_" + name
        else:
            p = None
        if p is not None and p in idx:
            row[j] = now[idx[p]]
    return o, row

def main():
    r = Robot()
    o, start = command_from_proprio(r)
    goal = start.copy()
    goal[2] += 0.05  # lift the right grip site vertically in the robot base frame
    actions = np.linspace(start, goal, 11)[1:]
    res = r.submit("ee_pose", actions, dt=0.05, interpolate="linear", cameras=CAMERAS,
                   include_depth=True, video="frames", note="cautious right-hand clearance lift")
    res.save("/app/runs/000-lift")
    print(res.meta)
    print("proprio_end", res.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now", [])[-36:])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float64)
    idx = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(layout)}
    action_layout = spec["action_types"]["ee_pose"]["layout"]
    row = np.zeros(len(action_layout), dtype=np.float64)
    for j, name in enumerate(action_layout):
        p = "cmd_" + name
        if p in idx:
            row[j] = now[idx[p]]
    return row

def backproject_pixel(u, v, depth_m, camera_meta):
    """Backproject an RGB-D pixel using current OpenGL cam2world calibration."""
    K = np.asarray(camera_meta["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=np.float64)
    T = np.asarray(camera_meta["cam2world_gl"], dtype=np.float64)
    # CV pixel coordinates map to OpenGL camera x-right, y-up, z-back.
    p_cam = np.array([
        (u - K[0, 2]) * depth_m / K[0, 0],
        -(v - K[1, 2]) * depth_m / K[1, 1],
        -depth_m,
        1.0,
    ])
    return (T @ p_cam)[:3]

def make_row_from_delta(start, *, dxyz=(0., 0., 0.), fingers=None):
    """Copy a command and add a right-hand xyz delta; fingers are six values."""
    row = np.array(start, dtype=np.float64, copy=True)
    row[:3] += np.asarray(dxyz, dtype=np.float64)
    if fingers is not None:
        row[12:18] = np.asarray(fingers, dtype=np.float64)
    return row

def submit_ramp(robot, start, goal, seconds, note, *, cameras=CAMERAS):
    """Submit a linear pose ramp, with one action row every 50 ms."""
    count = max(1, int(round(seconds / DT)))
    actions = np.linspace(start, goal, count + 1, dtype=np.float64)[1:]
    return robot.submit(
        "ee_pose", actions, dt=DT, interpolate="hold", cameras=cameras,
        include_depth=True, video="frames", note=note,
    )

def main():
    # Read-only summary when re-opened; the live episode already consumed its
    # single allowed run, so this record intentionally submits no more actions.
    r = Robot()
    status = r.status()
    print(json.dumps({
        "episode_status": status,
        "recorded_chunks": len(TRACE),
        "last_chunk": TRACE[-1],
        "runs_dir": "/app/runs",
        "current_action_submitted": False,
    }, indent=2))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
